title: Spectral Estimation with Deformed Decompression
abstract: arXiv:2611.26945v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sample covariance matrices are fundamental objects in machine learning and statistics, with valuable information encoded into their eigenvalues. When treating modern problems, the scale of these matrices can become prohibitive for tractable computation. This creates a critical need for "spectral decompression": a method for inferring the eigenspectrum of a very large-scale model using only information from its smaller realizations. Existing methods fall into two main categories: those relying on spectral inversion; and those that rely on Free Decompression techniques. On the one hand, spectral inversion is a fundamentally ill-posed problem that is notoriously unstable, often failing to yield reliable results in finite-size settings. translated_title: 基于形变解压缩的谱估计
translated_abstract: 样本协方差矩阵是机器学习和统计学中的基本对象，其特征值中编码了有价值的信息。在处理现代问题时，这些矩阵的规模可能会大到使可行计算变得不切实际。这就产生了对“谱解压缩”的关键需求：一种仅利用较小规模实现的信息来推断超大规模模型特征谱的方法。现有方法主要分为两类：一类依赖于谱求逆，另一类依赖于自由解压缩技术。一方面，谱求逆从根本上是一个病态问题，以不稳定性著称，在有限尺寸的情况下往往无法给出可靠的结果；另一方面，尽管最近提出的自由解压缩方法解决了这一规模问题，但其对Nica-Speicher框架的依赖将其应用限制在酉不变系综中，这是一种对称性条件……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为“形变解压缩”的谱估计新方法，旨在克服谱求逆的不稳定性以及自由解压缩仅适用于酉不变系综的局限，从而能够仅凭小规模矩阵的信息推断大规模样本协方差矩阵的特征谱。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Deformed Decompression," a novel spectral estimation method that overcomes the instability of spectral inversion and the unitary-invariance restriction of Free Decompression, enabling the inference of the eigenspectrum of large-scale sample covariance matrices from information of their smaller realizations.
